name: anna-mini-notes
description: Mini Notes with LLM Summary — an Anna App: engineered UI bundle + Anna storage Host API + Executa tool with sampling.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix executas/notes-summarizer install
scripts.executa:invoke: anna-app executa dev --dir executas/notes-summarizer --invoke summarize --args '{"notes":[{"order":1,"text":"明天跟客户 follow up"},{"order":2,"text":"修复登录 bug"}]}' --mock-sampling executas/notes-summarizer/fixtures/sampling-mock.jsonl
